title: RcaBundle
description: Root Cause Analysis bundle written for a failed test, matching the JSON produced by com.test.automation.sdk.reporting.RcaBundleWriter.toJson(Context). This schema documents the actual writer output as of SDK v1.5.1; it is not a literal resource loaded/validated at runtime by the SDK.

schemaVersion.description: RCA bundle format version, currently always 1.

generatedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 instant the bundle was generated.

status.description: Always "FAILED" -- RCA bundles are only written for failed tests.

recentLogLines.description: Tail of the SDK's sdk.log file, bounded by reporting.rcaBundle.logTailLines.

browserConsoleLog.description: Additive (SDK v1.5.1+), optional convenience path to the browser-console evidence file, when present in the evidence array. Absent (not null) when no browser-console evidence exists, so pre-v1.5.1 bundle consumers remain unaffected.

networkTrace.description: Additive (SDK v1.5.1+), optional convenience path to the *_network-trace.json evidence file, when present in the evidence array. Absent (not null) when no network-trace evidence exists.

suggestedNextSteps.description: Fixed four-item guidance list pointing the reader to screenshot, DOM, and log evidence before proposing a fix (see failure-investigation.instructions.md).

testIdentity.title: TestIdentity
testIdentity.description: All properties are optional strings, present only when non-empty at capture time.

environment.description: Value of the JVM system property 'environment' at capture time.

exceptionChain.title: ExceptionChain
exceptionChain.description: Empty object ({}) when the failure carried no throwable.

chain.description: Cause chain, root exception first, limited to 10 entries.

stackTrace.description: Top stack frames, bounded by reporting.rcaBundle.stackTraceFrames.

path.description: Filesystem path to the evidence artifact.
